what: the IN-TREE enumeration of the manufacturer/CAM written-acceptance items B01-B14 and the first-article validation groups FA01-FA10 that every release since D-789 has named only by count.  B01-B08 are Astra's Round-8 list, verbatim in substance.  B09-B14 and FA01-FA10 are this programme's own in-tree definition: the reviews added them by COUNT and the repository never held their text, so they are defined HERE, each mapped to a concrete step or fab-note item, and demo_feature_contract F12 refuses a release in which any FA group names a step the first-article plan does not contain.
